title: 15.85. Saraṇaduka, Maggārammaṇattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Araṇaṁ maggārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Araṇaṁ maggahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Araṇaṁ maggādhipatiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
